newsitem.title: UK: London commodity market holiday closures.
newsitem.headline: London commodity market holiday closures.

text.p: Planned Christmas/New Year holiday closures for London commodity markets are as follows -
Dec 27 - Full day. No regular Friday 0900 GMT stocks data.
Dec 24 - All close at 1230 GMT (1232 coffee).
Dec 27 - All have full day apart from wheat & barley/BIFFEX which close at 12.30 GMT.
Dec 31 - All close at 1230 GMT apart from cocoa which closes at 1530 GMT due to tender day.
FOSFA vegetable oils market and Meals/Feeds will offically only be closed on Dec 25/26 and Jan 1.
UK cash grain markets will stop trading when the LIFFE futures close.
